concept.title: People with neurological conditions
concept.shortdesc: People living with a named or general neurological condition such as Parkinson's, motor neurone disease, Huntington's or functional neurological disorder.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: multiple sclerosis: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (has its own cluster)
stroke or brain injury: see (not a progressive neurological condition)
